title: Structural, biophysical and biological analysis and characterisation of IRF4 DNA-binding domain mutations associated with multiple myeloma
authors: Natalie J. Tatum; Rebecca Scott; Gina M. Doody; Ian Hickson; Claire E. Jennings; Mathew P. Martin; Reuben M. Tooze; Julie A. Tucker; Anita Wittner; Lan-Zhen Wang; Eleanor K. Wright; Stephen R. Wedge; Martin E.M. Noble
one_liner_zh: 该文结合晶体结构、分子动力学模拟与多种生物物理实验，表征多发性骨髓瘤相关IRF4转录因子DNA结合域突变对DNA结合动力学和稳定性的影响，属于TF-DNA互作机制研究，但以实验为主、MD为辅，方法深度有限。
abstract: IRF4, a transcription factor in the interferon regulatory factor family, is a key regulator in immune cell differentiation indicated to have an essential role in the development of lymphoid malignancies. Genome-wide association studies previously identified a set of overlapping mutations within the IRF4 DNA-binding domain in T-cell lymphoma and multiple myeloma, several of which appeared to be associated with better prognosis. Mapping these mutations to the known crystal structure of the IRF4:PU.1:DNA ternary complex and a new structure of the IRF4 DNA-binding domain in the apo state suggested they might interfere with DNA-binding, directly or via destabilisation of domain structure. We characterised these cancer-associated IRF4 mutants experimentally using the recombinant IRF4 DNA-binding domain (DBD) in vitro and examined the clinically relevant mutant K123R in cellulo . Using fluorescence polarisation, surface plasmon resonance, differential scanning fluorimetry and molecular dynamics, we find that mutation may give rise to significant differences in DNA-binding kinetics and thermal stability without compromising the affinity of IRF4 DNA-binding. The K123R IRF4 mutant showed increased transcriptional activity via a luciferase reporter assay and increased nuclear partitioning, which may be preferentially selected for in multiple myeloma. We discuss our observations in relation to the improved prognosis conferred by this mutation.
abstract_zh: IRF4，作为干扰素调节因子家族中的一种转录因子，是免疫细胞分化中的关键调控因子，已被指出在淋巴恶性肿瘤的发展中扮演着至关重要的角色。全基因组关联研究先前在T细胞淋巴瘤和多发性骨髓瘤中识别出一组位于IRF4 DNA结合域内的重叠突变，其中几个突变似乎与更好的预后相关。将这些突变映射到已知的IRF4:PU.1:DNA三元复合物晶体结构以及一个新的IRF4 DNA结合域无配体状态结构上，提示它们可能通过直接干扰DNA结合或通过破坏域结构的稳定性来发挥作用。我们利用重组IRF4 DNA结合域（DBD）在体外对这些癌症相关IRF4突变体进行了实验表征，并在细胞内检测了临床相关突变K123R。通过荧光偏振、表面等离子体共振、差示扫描荧光法和分子动力学，我们发现突变可能导致DNA结合动力学和热稳定性的显著差异，而不损害IRF4 DNA结合的亲和力。K123R IRF4突变体通过荧光素酶报告基因检测显示出增强的转录活性，并增加了核分配，这可能在多发性骨髓瘤中被优先选择。我们讨论了这些观察结果与该突变带来的改善预后之间的关系。
